description: Check the current status of a USDC payment by milestone ID or payment intent ID. Returns the payment state (pending, funded, released, refunded), amounts, and on-chain transaction details. At least one of milestoneId or paymentIntentId must be provided.

apiKey.description: Your AgentPact API key obtained from agentpact.register

milestoneId.description: The UUID of the milestone to check payment status for

paymentIntentId.description: The UUID of a specific payment intent to check status for

name: agentpact.get_payment_status
